subject: FRACTION-PART function
notes: §15.42.4 r1's EAE (a - INTEGER-PART(a)) evaluated over seven arguments under ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD-DECIMAL, where §15.4.1 r1 makes equality mandatory. The floor split (a - INTEGER(a)) already fails the NOTE's own -1.5 case (+0.5 against r1's -0.5, because §15.44.4 r1 makes INTEGER(-1.5) = -2); the added |a| < 1 lines reach the region the NOTE cannot, where the subtrahend is zero and r1 returns the argument itself (-0.25 against the floor split's +0.75).
